de.abas.erp.db.selection

Class Key<O extends FieldValueProvider>

  • Object
    • Key<O>
  • Type Parameters:
    O - Owner type

    public final class Key<O extends FieldValueProvider>
extends Object
    A instance of this class describes a search key for a selection. This class equates the @sort option of the abas selection syntax.

    mm
